title: 'choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn' not enforced
expected: abilities/effects/choice.ts:22-30 builds the choose-mode pendingChoice with options = all indices (line 24) and never copies effect.notChosenThisTurn onto it nor reads the source card's modesChosenThisTurn meta. The only consumer, game-definition/moves/pending-choice.ts:636, records modesChosenThisTurn only `if (choice.notChosenThisTurn)` — a field no code path ever sets (grep shows no other writer in engine src). So for sfd-049-221 (aphelios-exalted.ts sets notChosenThisTurn: true on the effect), every attach trigger offers [0,1,2], repeat picks of mode 0 pass the `choice.options.includes(idx)` check at :629, and meta stays unset.
observed: Second and later attach triggers in the same turn still presented options [0,1,2]; picking mode 0 again was accepted. Card meta modesChosenThisTurn stayed unset. handle_choice (abilities/effects/choice.ts) does not copy effect.notChosenThisTurn onto the choose-mode pendingChoice nor filter options by modesChosenThisTurn, so the reducer's recording branch never runs.
